title: Venezuelan Plantain Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Venezuela, made with plantains and a variety of earthy spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the stew meat in batches until browned on all sides.
Add onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add plantains, vegetable broth, and browned stew meat to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the stew for 2-3 hours, or until the plantains are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions.
